visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up view shows a bowl of steaming stir-fried chicken gizzards mixed with bright red and green chili peppers and purple onion slices. Steam rises visibly against a dark background. Text "辣炒雞胗" and "wecook123" are centered in the frame. Lighting is bright studio lighting, highlighting the moist textures of the meat and glazed vegetables. (2) Hands of a chef are seen using a sharp steel knife to slice raw, dark red chicken gizzards on a light-colored wooden cutting board. The slices are cut thin with precise, repetitive movements. The background is simple and out of focus, centering the viewer's attention entirely on the board and the raw ingredients. (3) Sliced gizzards are placed into a clear glass bowl on a clean kitchen counter. Hands wearing transparent plastic gloves sprinkle white powder and pour soy sauce and rice wine into the bowl, then mix the contents thoroughly with a squeezing and folding motion to ensure even marination. (4) A large, shallow off-white frying pan on a stove is shown from a high angle. The marinated gizzards are poured into the hot pan from the glass bowl. Oil is drizzled from a glass bottle with a metal spout. A red and black spatula stirs the meat as it sizzles. (5) Small glass bowls containing dried red chili circles, spicy bean paste, minced garlic, fresh red chili slices, and chopped purple onions are added sequentially to the pan. The camera zooms in closer, capturing the colorful interaction of ingredients as they are tossed and stirred. (6) More seasonings including rice wine, white pepper, salt, and sugar are added from small containers. Sliced green chilies and chopped scallions are tossed in for final color. The chef uses the spatula to continuously stir-fry the mixture, ensuring even coating of the dark, savory sauce. (7) The finished dish is beautifully presented in a decorative dark-patterned ceramic bowl. The camera performs a slow zoom-in, showcasing the glossy, spicy sauce and the variety of vibrant ingredients. Steam continues to rise from the dish, creating a warm and appetizing visual conclusion.

The BGM tempo remains steady while the narrator's excitement increases, using varied pitch contours to emphasize the appetizing nature of the dish. The sizzling sound of the pan remains prominent as the focal sound effect until it fades out along with a final acoustic guitar flourish. The overall mix is well-balanced and polished.
